description: Installation for one or more components: the one-time @layro registry setup for components.json, the shadcn CLI command (always @layro/<slug>, never a bare URL), a ready-to-run agent command with a 15-minute install token when this connection carries a CLI token, the npm packages still missing (pass installed_packages from package.json), the files and where they go, and the theme setup.

installed_packages.description: npm packages the project already has (from package.json), so they are not suggested again.

mode.description: Default "cli": the shadcn CLI install, packages and files. "manual" or "both" adds copy-by-hand steps, for when you cannot run the CLI.

name: get_installation
title: Install Layro components
